channel.title: 9nth Dimension
channel.description: The parts of the Bible most churches skip: lost texts, prophecy, Old Testament mysteries and how the canon was formed, told straight, with the references, so you can go deeper in your faith.

item.title: What are the Dead Sea Scrolls and what do they tell us about the Bible?
item.description: Ancient Jewish manuscripts found near Qumran from 1947, including the oldest known Old Testament copies. Here's what they reveal about how the Bible was copied.

item.title: Who were the Nephilim in Genesis 6?
item.description: The Nephilim appear in Genesis 6:4 and Numbers 13:33. The text calls them mighty men of old; who they were is still debated. Here are the main readings.

item.title: What is the Book of Enoch and why isn't it in the Bible?
item.description: 1 Enoch is an ancient Jewish book written in Enoch's name centuries before Jesus. Jude quotes it, but most churches left it out. Here's what it is and why.

item.title: What to do when prayer feels dry
item.description: Dry prayer is a normal stage of spiritual growth, not a sign that God is gone. Here's why it happens and five practical ways to keep praying through it.
